deliver: Deliver both sealed envelopes to Tender Box 4, Ground Floor, Northern Utilities Procurement Authority, Administrative Building C, Sakaka before 14:00 Riyadh time on the PDD (VOL-I 6.1, Appendix 3; late Proposals are rejected unopened, VOL-I 6.6) | A1 requirement ids: VOL-I-6.1-01, VOL-I-6.2-01, VOL-I-9.1-01, VOL-I-App3-01 | Document control; document_controller; x1 | elapsed 1 WD (delivery), staff effort 1 WD, waits on: nobody external | ES 2026-12-29 EF 2026-12-29 LS 2026-12-10 LF 2026-12-10 float -13 WD | timing: INFEASIBLE by 13 WD | decision: READY | resource: OK | after: seal-and-mark | flags: INFEASIBLE by 13 WD (total float -13 WD: earliest start 2026-12-29 (after seal-and-mark) is after the latest start 2026-12-10; not compressed) | REVIEW (proposed relationship): VOL-I-6.1-01 reached from VOL-I:6.1 via REL-AI-003; dates unchanged (a relationship, not a direct citation)

consortium-check: Confirm the Proposal is submitted by the Bidder prequalified and named in VOL-I Appendix 1, with no change to its composition, shareholding or lead member, or that the Authority's prior written consent to any change is held (VOL-I 1.4, 8.1) | A1 requirement ids: VOL-I-1.4-01, VOL-I-8.1-01 | Legal; legal_counsel; x1 | elapsed 1 WD (consortium_confirmation), staff effort 0.5 WD, waits on: nobody external | ES 2026-11-08 EF 2026-11-08 LS 2026-11-24 LF 2026-11-24 float 12 WD | timing: OK | decision: READY | resource: OK | after: none (starts from the planning date) | flags: none

ground-dd: Review the data-room geotechnical report and satisfy the Bidder as to ground conditions (e.g. the wadi crossing; ADD-01 Q4); feed the construction methodology and the price | A1 requirement ids: ADD-01-Q4-01, VOL-I-5.5-01 | Technical; technical_lead; x1 | elapsed 10 WD (ground_due_diligence), staff effort 6 WD, waits on: nobody external | ES 2026-11-08 EF 2026-11-19 LS 2026-11-12 LF 2026-11-25 float 4 WD | timing: OK | decision: READY | resource: OK | after: none (starts from the planning date) | flags: none

attendance-notice: If the attendance record is wrong, notify the Authority through the Portal | A1 requirement ids: ADD-01-3.1-01, VOL-I-5.4-01 | Bid management; bid_manager; x1 | elapsed 2 WD (clarification_drafting), staff effort 1.5 WD, waits on: nobody external | ES 2026-11-08 EF 2026-11-09 LS 2026-10-13 LF 2026-10-14 float -18 WD | timing: CONDITIONAL — window elapsed 2026-10-14; whether the condition arose is not known | decision: READY | resource: NOT LOADED (timing status CONDITIONAL: no work is scheduled) | after: none (starts from the planning date) | flags: CONDITIONAL — window elapsed 2026-10-14; whether the condition arose is not known (ATTENDANCE-NOTICE = 2026-10-14 is before the planning date 2026-11-08; needed only if the Bidder considers its attendance at the Pre-Bid Conference to have been incorrectly recorded (ADD-01 3.1); an elapsed window alone does not establish a missed duty: a person records whether the condition arose and, if it did, what was done)
g.text: CONDITIONAL: window elapsed, not known if needed

svg.text: INFEASIBLE: negative float, shortfall in WD (never compressed)
ask by: last day to decide whether to raise a clarification request
OPEN DECISION: finalisation needs it by (bar = the activity)
OVERLOAD: role over capacity that day

PROPOSAL, not reviewed. Timing, decision readiness and resource feasibility are separate statuses; resource levelling is NOT implemented; overloads are reported, not resolved. No bidder references, certificates, attendance or financial standing are assumed to exist.

Each row: activity id, count, then the A1 requirement ids that fit (+n more); ALL ids are in the row's hover title, gantt.html and programme.csv. Load window: late (LS..LF, clipped at the planning date).

Milestones outside the chart: Reference look-back start 2016-12-11 (conservative; 2016-12-10 if the boundary day counts); Blackout start 2026-09-14; Pre-Bid Conference 10:00 2026-09-30; Site visit (optional) 2026-10-01; Proposal validity end 2027-05-09 (conservative; 2027-05-08 if the PDD counts as day 1); Bid bond validity end 2027-07-08 (conservative; 2027-07-07 if the PDD counts as day 1).

REVIEW (<status> ...) tags: Relationship status: confirmed = stated in the documents (the entry quotes the cross-reference), not confirmed by a person; proposed = inferred by a curator or a model, a person decides; possible = a weaker inference.

form-4e: VOL-I 9.6 CHECK (Form 4-E against the whole Proposal; form_4e_checks.csv): form-4a, form-4b, lcc-certificate, form-4f, model-audit-opinion final after Form 4-E starts on 2026-12-06; a strict order (Form 4-E after every Proposal document) INFEASIBLE by 15 WD on the assumed durations; 13 WD of it existed before the ordering (assemble-envelope-a, copies, deliver, fin-model-build, fin-model-freeze,

form-4f, lcc-certificate, lcc-ratio, model-audit-opinion, seal-and-mark already late); the ordering itself adds 2 WD and makes late form-4e, model-audit-review, model-auditor-appoint; how Form 4-E is cross-checked against the documents final after it starts: decision recorded on I-FORM-4E-CROSS-CHECK; whether and how Form 4-E can list a qualification of a commercial term without commercial information (VOL-I
9.6, 6.2, 10.5): decision recorded on I-FORM-4E-COMMERCIAL-QUALIFICATION; no duration, setting or dependency was changed
